title: When Does Compensating Inherited Quantization Error Help? Mean-Square Guarantees for Layer-Wise Quantization and Their Limits
abstract: arXiv:2610.16020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Layer-wise post-training quantization methods let each layer compensate for the quantization error inherited from earlier layers. We ask under what assumptions such compensation guarantees a network output error no larger than without it. For linear networks of any depth, with the required calibration Gram matrices invertible, if the rounding error of each layer has zero conditional mean and a deterministic second-moment map common to both schemes, as under subtractive dither on an unbounded grid, then compensation with strengths in $[0,1]$ fixed in advance gives a mean-square output error no larger than no compensation, each scheme being followed along its own trajectory. The exact gain separates error removed directly from reduced excitation of later rounding noise. Outside this setting the comparison can fail. translated_title: 补偿继承的量化误差何时有效？逐层量化的均方误差保证及其局限
translated_abstract: 逐层训练后量化方法允许每一层对从先前层继承来的量化误差进行补偿。我们研究在何种假设下，这种补偿能保证网络输出误差不大于不进行补偿时的误差。对于任意深度的线性网络，在所需的校准Gram矩阵可逆的条件下，如果每一层的舍入误差具有零条件均值，且两种方案共享一个确定性的二阶矩映射（例如在无界网格上的减法抖动情形），那么采用事先固定在[0,1]区间内的补偿强度进行补偿，其均方输出误差不会大于不补偿的情形，其中每种方案各自沿自身的轨迹运行。精确的增益将直接消除的误差与后续舍入噪声激励降低的效果区分开来。在此设定之外，这种比较可能失效。对于修正线性单元（ReLU）激活，该保证因两个独立的原因而失效：噪声会改变激活状态，而且即使没有……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文给出了逐层量化中误差补偿的理论保证：在线性网络、可逆校准Gram矩阵及零条件均值舍入误差的假设下，补偿的均方输出误差始终不劣于不补偿，但同时证明了在ReLU等非线性激活下该保证会因噪声改变激活状态等原因而失效。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes mean-square error guarantees for error compensation in layer-wise quantization—showing that for linear networks with invertible calibration Gram matrices and zero conditional mean rounding errors, compensation never performs worse than no compensation, while proving the guarantee fails under nonlinear activations like ReLU due to noise-induced activation state changes.
